content.title: Is Publix Open or Closed on Easter Sunday? Details on 2026 Store Hours
content.text: Sunday, April 5, is Easter. The annual holiday is one of the biggest commemorations on the Christian calendar. In honor of the occasion, many people attend church service, gather with loved ones or participate in other Easter activities.However you plan to spend Easter Sunday this year, whether it be hosting brunch for friends and family or simply enjoying a bit of spring weather, a trip to the grocery store may be on your weekend agenda. If that's the case, and Publix is your go-to grocer, you might be wondering if Publix will be open on Easter. For the most up-to-date information, TODAY.com reached out to the grocery chain to find out if Publix locations will offer Easter hours in 2026 or, if like other retail giants (including Target, Lowe's and Costco), stores will be closed. See below for the latest details on whether or not Publix will be open Sunday or if you need to go elsewhere to grab any last-minute Easter essentials.Either way, given that many restaurants and retailers are closed on Easter, or operate with adjusted hours, it's a good idea to confirm local store hours for any business you're visiting this weekend, before heading out the door. Is Publix Open on Easter in 2026?Publix has more than 1,400 store locations across Alabama, Florida, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee and Virginia.If you’re planning to shop at the grocery chain this Easter, you’ll have to go elsewhere. According to a Publix' spokesperson, “Publix stores will be open normal operating hours on Saturday, April 4, the day before Easter Sunday. Our stores will be closed on Easter Sunday in observance of the holiday and to allow our associates the opportunity to spend time with family and friends.” Stores will resume regular business hours on Monday, April 6.Publix stores typically close on three holidays each year: Easter, Thanksgiving and Christmas Day. Stores Open on Easter 2026Though Publix will be closed on Sunday, see below for a sampling of stores that will remain open on Easter or find a complete list right here. BJ’s Wholesale Club: A majority of BJ’s clubs will be open on Easter Sunday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. BJ’s recommends confirming local hours before going. Find local hours here.Dollar General: Stores will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here.Home Depot: Stores are open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Hours may vary by location.
